simple.meaning: עֶבְרֹן (ʻEbrôn) is a Hebrew word meaning “Ebron , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.usage: Hebron. Perhaps a clerical error for 5658 .
definitions.full: H5683. Ebron עֶבְרֹן proper name, of a location Josh 19:38 ( ᵐ5 Ελβων , A ᵐ5 L Αχραν ); read probably עַבְדֹּן q. v.

occurrences.englishText: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
